title: Census of Israel’s Tribes

questions.question: Where did God speak to Moses to command the census?
options: In the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: In the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:1 (ESV): "The Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting..."

questions.question: Who was to be counted in the census?
options: Every male from twenty years old and upward, able to go to war
questions.correctAnswer: Every male from twenty years old and upward, able to go to war
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:3 (ESV): "You and Aaron shall list them... every male from twenty years old and upward... able to go to war."

questions.question: Which tribe was NOT listed in the census of fighting men?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:47 (ESV): "But the Levites were not listed along with them by their ancestral tribe."

questions.question: Who assisted Moses and Aaron in the census?
options: A man from each tribe, each being the head of the house of his fathers
questions.correctAnswer: A man from each tribe, each being the head of the house of his fathers
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:4 (ESV): "And there shall be with you a man from each tribe, each being the head of the house of his fathers."

questions.question: What was the total number of men able to go to war?
Which tribe had the largest number of men?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:27 (ESV): "Those listed of the tribe of Judah were 74,600." (Checking other numbers confirms Judah is largest).

questions.question: Which tribe had the smallest number of men?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:35 (ESV): "Those listed of the tribe of Manasseh were 32,200." (Compare: Benjamin 35,400 etc).

questions.question: When was this census taken relative to the exodus?
options: On the first day of the second month, in the second year
Immediately after crossing the Red Sea
questions.correctAnswer: On the first day of the second month, in the second year
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:1 (ESV): "On the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Why were the Levites not numbered with the rest?
options: They were appointed over the tabernacle of the testimony
questions.correctAnswer: They were appointed over the tabernacle of the testimony
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:50 (ESV): "But appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony... they are to camp around the tabernacle."

questions.question: What happens if a stranger comes near the tabernacle?
options: He shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:51 (ESV): "And if any outsider comes near, he shall be put to death."

questions.question: Who was the head of the tribe of Judah assisting Moses?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:7 (ESV): "From Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab."

questions.question: How many men were in the tribe of Reuben?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:21 (ESV): "Those listed of the tribe of Reuben were 46,500."

questions.question: Who was the head of the tribe of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:10 (ESV): "From the sons of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud."

questions.question: What specific age criterion was used for the census?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:3 (ESV): "From twenty years old and upward."

questions.question: The Levites were to camp in what formation relative to the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Numbers 1:53 (ESV): "But the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that there may be no wrath..."

key_verse_text: Take a census of all the congregation of the people of Israel, by clans, by fathers' houses... every male from twenty years old and upward, all in Israel who are able to go to war.
